description:
Returns the free dates of a space (and the free hours of that day, if it is sold by the hour).

Hours are in 24h format and in the VENUE'S LOCAL TIME, never UTC: the IANA time zone is in the `timezone` field of the response.

Reports availability as dates/hours, without occupancy levels. The final confirmation happens at checkout.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD. If given, the response focuses on that day and includes the free hours when the space is sold by the hour.

people_count.description: Number of people, to warn if there may not be enough room.

utm_source.description: MCP client that originates the request, for attribution.

name: check_availability

available_hours.description: Free START times, HH:MM in the venue's local time (`timezone`). Only present if the space is sold by the hour and a date was requested. For TODAY it starts at the next hour, not at opening: past hours cannot be booked and are not listed.

bookable_hours.description: Start times that can actually be booked for one hour, HH:MM in the venue's local time. Same condition as `available_hours`. Unlike it, never includes the closing time and drops hours that overlap an existing booking. A booking of N hours needs N consecutive entries.

booking_url.description: Checkout URL with the requested date already filled in. Only present if that date is free.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the venue. `available_hours` is in THIS zone, not UTC.

title: Check availability
